# Iron Citadel

The Iron Citadel is a massive fortress stronghold located in the frozen north. It serves as the primary base of operations for the [[factions/crimson_order]] and stands as a symbol of their military might.

## Architecture

Carved into the mountainside and reinforced with steel and stone, the Citadel is nearly impregnable. Its walls have never been successfully breached, and its garrison is one of the best-trained in the realm.

## Strategic Importance

The fortress's position controls access to northern trade routes and serves as a staging point for military campaigns throughout the region. From the Citadel, the Crimson Order projects power across vast territories.
